dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts small businesses nationwide by providing voluntary AI resources, as well as federal personnel at NIST and SBA.
dimensions.evidence: develop or identify, and disseminate... resources for small business concerns... relating to artificial intelligence

dimensions.assessment: Provision of voluntary technical standards, best practices, and educational frameworks with no mandatory compliance requirements for businesses.
dimensions.evidence: The use of the resources described in paragraph (1) shall be considered voluntary.

dimensions.assessment: Activities are explicitly conditioned upon the availability of appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: Subject to the availability of appropriations, the Director shall... develop or identify, and disseminate... resources

dimensions.assessment: Amends the National Institute of Standards and Technology Act to add specific duties regarding AI resources for small businesses and biennial updates.
dimensions.evidence: Section 22A of the National Institute of Standards and Technology Act (15 U.S.C. 278h-1) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Requires permanent, ongoing biennial reviews and updates of the resources by NIST.
dimensions.evidence: not less frequently than once every two years thereafter, the Director shall carry out... Review... Update

missing_information: Specific dollar amounts authorized for appropriations to execute the provisions.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs NIST to develop, review, update, and disseminate voluntary artificial intelligence resources for small businesses in coordination with the Small Business Administration.
